scope: Real provider responses through deterministic validation/execution on synthetic work. Excludes voice, browser, network to app, persistence and student usability. Explanation grade checks response type/non-mutation, not pedagogical quality.
methodology: Sequential matched cases, alternating prompt order by case/repetition; identical schema, tools, model, context and three-call/40s budget. Default provider caching retained; usage records expose cached input tokens. Failures retained, missing attempts explicit. Small exploratory sample, not a production latency guarantee.
